_comment: Literal find->replace patches applied to the vendored ValveResourceFormat clone by tools/vendor.ps1 / tools/vendor.sh. Each find snippet must appear EXACTLY ONCE in the pristine upstream file; a miss or a duplicate aborts the apply so the drift is reviewed rather than silently dropped. Rationale for each patch is in third_party/PATCHES.md.

patches.description: Open the Panorama.Data AND Panorama.CRC32 setters so ResourceBuilder can author .vsvg_c icons from a template: replace Data, then refresh CRC32 (upstream's Serialize writes the stored checksum verbatim; it does not recompute).
Add a recursion-depth counter (Context.Depth) used by the KV3 read guard below.

Bound KV3 binary-parser recursion depth (512) so a hostile deeply-nested resource raises a catchable InvalidDataException instead of an uncatchable StackOverflowException that crashes the process. ReadBinaryValue is the single chokepoint every nested value passes through. SECURITY: reachable anonymously via /rig/upload and on any bare VRF parse.

Implement VBIB.Serialize as a byte-exact passthrough (upstream throws NotImplementedException). The pure-C# vmdl_c RERL/DATA rewrite (ModelSwapStage) re-serializes the whole resource; vertex/index buffers are byte-stable, so writing them back verbatim lets the rewrite land. Was applied inline only before this entry; now tracked so it survives re-vendoring.

Clamp attacker-declared vtex Width/Height/Depth before any buffer/SKBitmap allocation. A crafted vtex (UInt16 dims up to 65535 each) overflows CalculateBufferSizeForMipLevel's unchecked Int32 size math and/or demands tens of GB, OOMing the process. SECURITY (audit F7): reachable via /compile/gltf + /v1/compile/gltf material decode on an uploaded model.

GetIntegerArray: unchecked UInt64 -> long element conversion (0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF -> -1L). Community models store m_refMeshGroupMasks as UInt64 all-bits; the checked path threw OverflowException and cost 32 library models their mesh-group reads (variant schema/bake, glTF variant export). Mirrors upstream GetUnsignedIntegerArray unchecked handling.

Open the Resource.Version setter. It is the one header field Serialize() writes that only Read() could previously supply, so a private setter is what forced every from-scratch author to start from a donor file of the right type. With it open, .vtex_c / .vsvg_c / .vmat_c containers can be authored outright.

Check a KV3 block's declared buffer, blob and compressed sizes against the block before renting buffers sized by them, and set the node budget from them. The decompressed total may not exceed BinaryKV3.MaxUncompressedBytes (vrf-kv3-read-limit); a standalone KV3 (Size 0, e.g. a nav mesh) is bounded by the rest of the stream. SECURITY: a few hundred hostile bytes otherwise asked for gigabytes (s2c fuzz, 2026-10-12), and a 454 KB zstd block declaring 1.9 GB passed the old 4096x ratio (2026-10-18). A v5 zstd block with blobs must fit its compressed total, which bounds the blob frame.

The legacy VKV3 reader rented binary_bc's and binary_lz4's declared decompressed size straight from the file: about 40 bytes of binary_bc rented 1907 MB (F12 review). Both are now held to vrf-kv3-size-guard's rule before renting: non-negative, stored bytes within what is left (a standalone KV3 needs a seekable stream), and at most BinaryKV3.MaxUncompressedBytes. SECURITY.

BinaryKV3.MaxUncompressedBytes (default 512 MB, above the largest real block measured: 303 MB, de_boulder world_physics PHYS) and UseMaxUncompressedBytes, an AsyncLocal scope that only lowers it. The ceiling vrf-kv3-size-guard enforces. SECURITY: lets a host bound per-request memory on untrusted uploads.
Refuse a string count larger than buffer 1 before allocating the string table. SECURITY (s2c fuzz).
Clamp an array length from the file to 4096 where it is only a capacity hint. SECURITY (s2c fuzz): one hostile length otherwise reserved gigabytes before an element was read.
Refuse a block count larger than the stream can hold before reserving the block list. SECURITY (s2c fuzz).

Refuse a RERL entry count larger than its block can hold (16 bytes an entry) before ResourceRefInfoList.EnsureCapacity reserves space for it. SECURITY (s2c fuzz, 2026-10-13): a mutated vpcf_c reserved gigabytes from one hostile count. Raises InvalidDataException.
